compile_check.description: Schema 4: the compile check proven per tree.

landing.description: Schema 4: the landing policy (FAE-CTL-030): known flaky tests the suite gate tolerates and allowlisted frozen-region checks. A landing request cannot widen it.

required_tests.description: Schema 4: always-required QA commands, optionally path-scoped (FAE-WF-085).

description: POST /v1/rpc over an owner-only Unix-domain socket. Credentials resolve to server-configured principals; request fields cannot select an actor. Read RPCs default to a five-second deadline and coalesce within authenticated scope. GET /v1/events?after=N streams committed NDJSON events and explicit retention/overflow gaps. Supported task-control methods include Escalate, Block, Cancel, Defer, Undefer, Reprioritize, SetAttemptLimit, RestartWithInformation, ResumeWithContext and Resume. Mutation citations must satisfy action permissions and message-class consumption. Prophet chats enqueue asynchronous task/global liaison turns; bounded pages carry replies and outcomes. BacklogAdmit validates a graph atomically; BacklogEdge edits dependencies; BacklogShow reports readiness; ReconcileDone repairs proven landed mirrors. Retire accepts superseded-by, contained, or obsolete reasons and updates dependency handling atomically. Read methods accept include_retired=false by default. TargetConfigPut/Get/List/Retire manage immutable local target policies; admissions pin target_config and target_revision. Target schema v2 pins Normal-mode installed adapters and review/ticket policies. Census produces a reviewed snapshot artifact; CensusApply retires one unchanged row. PlaneBackup verifies an offline restore; CleanupRetired requires that backup and archives all candidates before deletion. Backup and cleanup have scoped two-minute deadlines; shorter caller deadlines still apply. AdapterPut/Get/List/Retire manage immutable schema-discovered adapter revisions and first-write retirement tombstones. Retirement refuses new bindings but preserves already bound tasks and pending preparations. Target schema v3 pins a separate adapter bundle. ReviewWorkspacePlan computes owned bindings; operator ReviewWorkspacePrepare provisions and baseline-checks the task workspace outside the drive. Optional fleet provisioning persists exact intent and attempted marker before a single mutation, then verified binding receipt before baseline readiness; uncertain retries query without replay. Scratch cleanup is a local controller operation with creation-time marker and externally retained backups. BackupRetention previews and applies a digest-bound policy while retaining historical cleanup coverage. BackupReplicate uses a durable attempted marker, receipt query recovery and remote content checksum verification. BackupRetentionSchedule configures, pauses, resumes and inspects an opt-in durable plane-backup retention policy; scheduled runs revalidate operator authorization and preserve all retention safeguards. Scratch-archive cleanup is an offline owner-only preview/apply operation that removes only exact redundant copies while preserving the canonical completed-cleanup archive. BackupSchedule controls durable automatic verified plane-backup creation. BackupReplicationSchedule processes one verified local backup per interval, preserving a pending source/destination across restart and using query-only recovery after uncertain upload. Both require fresh explicit recurring authority and run outside provider workflows. BackupReplicationUnpin previews and applies a digest-bound release of a replication source pin after proving every remote replica and excluding pending claims. BackupQuota configures durable byte and backup-count admission limits, counts partial backups and replication spool files, and preserves data on an export overrun. TaskCreate admits one task into the live graph through backlog admission's validation and refuses an existing identity; TaskUpdate edits a non-terminal task's admission fields from its next stage; TaskDelete withdraws or stops and retires a non-terminal task, keeping its history; TaskGet reads one task's admission fields, superseded_fields, pending_delete, edges, trace and edits (daemon/TASKS.md).

deadline.description: Optional absolute request deadline. Default server maximum is five seconds; authenticated PlaneBackup, BackupRetention, BackupReplicate, CleanupRetired and ReviewWorkspacePrepare allow up to two minutes.
